legend: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving the kidney, showing glomerular capillaries distended by tumour cells.
Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving the kidney shows large, dark-staining lymphoid cells in glomerular capillaries and in a peritubular capillary.

Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving a cutaneous haemangioma, showing capillaries distended by tumour cells (<<31084>>). Higher-magnification view shows large tumour cells with vesicular chromatin and several small nucleoli filling vascular spaces; apoptotic tumour cells are present (<<31085>>). CD34 immunohistochemistry highlighting large tumour B cells restricted to intravascular spaces (<<31079>>).

Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma in the cerebral white matter (<<31285>>). Tumour cells are highlighted by CD20 immunohistochemistry (<<31286>>). Perivascular microglia and astrocytes are activated (<<31148>>).

In the cerebral white matter, two capillaries harbour a cluster of tumour cells or single CD20+ blasts of a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Anti-CD20 immunostaining, slight counterstaining with haemalum.
Remarkable haemophagocytosis by a macrophage is shown in the bone marrow in a patient with haemophagocytic subtype (May–Grünwald–Giemsa).

CD20 highlighting intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving the lung, distending alveolar capillaries and larger vascular spaces.
